summary: @servicetitan/navigation preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: Version 14.1.4 of this package declares scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts and chmods the binary, then execFileSyncs it against math_init.js — a 727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated bundle (rotating string array, custom base-N decoder with a hc1jfK9 alphabet, `with` blocks that break strict-mode parsing) shipped at the tarball root. The package advertises React navigation UI components with only `classnames` as a runtime dependency; neither the alternate-runtime dropper nor the obfuscated payload has any counterpart in the declared `src`/`dist` directories or any UI-related purpose. The `files` field lists only ["dist","src"] yet math_init.js and setup.mjs sit at the tarball root outside those declared directories. The preinstall hook fires automatically on `npm install`, causing an opaque 727KB payload — whose contents cannot be audited from the shipped source — to execute on the installer's machine under a downloaded Bun runtime that evades Node-based tooling.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
